meta.description: The zerosoft brand: the zero, the color of each app and the typefaces.

default.title: The brand
default.lead: White, black and zeros. Color belongs to the apps: it tells you where you are.
default.logoBody: The zero and the lowercase name, in mono. The zero alone is the icon: favicon, app and avatar.
default.productsBody: Each app has its color, used as an accent: the app zero, the active item, a chart line. Never as a page background.
